data.name: Dread Mariner
data.detailed_description:
The Dread Mariners were created to fight against those who would take our oceans.  You're the only one left.  Explore the drained world to find the items and abilities necessary to avenge the lost, and exact revenge against the ones who killed your crew mates.

Key Features

Combat

Wielding a giant anchor and using Spectral, Elemental, and Eldritch powers, hack and slash your way through hordes of enemies.  Use your Spectral Lash to grab onto far away enemies and shoot towards them to dole out the most pain you can.  Throw out an Eldritch imbued anchor that emanates power to you, or twists the minds of enemies near it.

Progression

Level up by defeating monsters, taking what the items they drop to grow your arsenal.  Hunt down mini-bosses to get their otherworldly abilities to use against their corrupted allies.

World

Explore the desiccated ocean floor as you fight through lands claimed by twisted, semi-sentient elementals, spectral forms of those claimed by the seas, and horrors from the deepest trenches. Fight through 3 zones that include mini-bosses, bosses, and hordes of enemies, delving into procedurally generated dungeons along the way to put your skills to the test.

Nonlinear Story

Messages in bottles can be read in your own time to discern how the previous chapter of the world came to a close.  These personal messages left by your former crew mates convey the thoughts and nightmares of these fallen brothers and sisters.

data.short_description: Play as the Dread Mariner in this indie ARPG fighting through a world stripped of life and resources to protect the last bastion of humanity and avenge your fallen crew mates. Explore a hand crafted world and randomly generated dungeons in order to kill a variety of mobs, mini bosses, and bosses.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Dread Mariner is a 2D sprite based isometric ARPG that includes the typical violence seen in games like Diablo 1 and Diablo 2. The graphics are not high fidelity or realistic and the graphics are pixelated in a way that hides a lot of that detail. 

Dread Mariner does take place in a world that has had most of humanity wiped away with depictions of loneliness, trauma, PTSD, and an overall dark tone.
